title: Hacker News: Azure Data Theft Campaign Reported
description: Recent reports highlight a hacker campaign targeting Microsoft Azure, allegedly stealing millions of employee records from Fortune 500 companies.

sections.heading: Corporate Targets
paragraphs: According to SecurityWeek, Fortune 500 companies have been hit in an Azure data theft campaign.

paragraphs: The Register reports that a crook is hawking millions of records allegedly plundered from corporate Azure tenants.
